cards.name: Schema Validator

cards.description: Validates Aurora directed-graph invariants (root Mission, reachability, inbound link requirements, and link target existence).
cards.name: Invariant Validator

cards.description: Renders human-friendly Markdown for each card and generates an index README grouped by card type.
cards.name: Markdown Card Generator

cards.description: Enforce stable ordering for file traversal, link rendering, and grouped output generation to make documentation diff-friendly.
cards.name: Deterministic Ordering

cards.description: Ensure aurora_cli writes only within the user-configured output root and avoids unsafe path traversal.
cards.name: Output Path Sanitization

cards.description: Reduce manual effort by generating documentation and standard views directly from the authoritative Aurora model.
cards.name: Operational Friction Elimination

cards.name: Trustworthy Model Validation

cards.description: Ensure architecture can be communicated consistently by generating a standardized, human-friendly card catalog and a repeatable set of views.
cards.name: Automate Architecture Communication

cards.name: Aurora Model Folder

cards.name: Documentation Output Folder

cards.name: Command Invoked

cards.description: All card JSON files have been loaded into an in-memory graph.
cards.name: Model Loaded

cards.description: Schema validation and invariant checks have completed.
cards.name: Validation Completed

cards.description: Provide a validate subcommand that checks schema conformance and Aurora invariants and returns a non-zero exit code on failure.
cards.name: Validate Command

cards.description: Provide a render-cards subcommand that generates one Markdown file per card and a grouped index README.
cards.name: Render Cards Command

cards.description: Provide a render-views subcommand that generates the standard set of view diagrams from the model, skipping any empty views.
cards.name: Render Views Command

cards.description: Provide an all subcommand that validates the model then generates cards and views in a single run.
cards.name: All Command

cards.description: Generate the standard view set (Requirements View, System Composition, Deployment Topology, Process Flow, and State Machine) using model cards and link relationships.
cards.name: Standard View Set Generation

cards.description: Provide bump-major, bump-minor, and bump-patch subcommands that update audit_trail.version and append an audit_trail.history entry with editor and timestamp.
cards.name: Bump Version Commands

cards.description: Provide a `compact` subcommand that writes a compact JSON snapshot of the model to a single file with top-level `{ "cards": [...] }`, where each card is stripped of `audit_trail` and each link is stripped of the `relationship` field. Output is deterministic (stable ordering) for diff-friendly automation.
cards.name: Compact Model Export Command

cards.description: A stable CLI contract consisting of subcommands, flags, exit codes, and structured output conventions.
cards.name: Command Line Interface

cards.description: A contract defining standard view names, included card types, layout defaults (ELK), and per-card-type shape mapping.
cards.name: View Rendering Contract

cards.description: Provide a first-party command-line tool that validates Aurora models and deterministically generates human-friendly documentation and standard views so architects can model systems without hand-drawing diagrams or manually maintaining documentation.
cards.name: Enable Deterministic Aurora CLI Tooling

cards.description: End-to-end process for resolving a model, validating it, and generating documentation outputs.
cards.name: Aurora CLI Execution

cards.description: Process of rendering human-friendly Markdown cards and standard views from a validated model.
cards.name: Documentation Generation

cards.description: aurora_cli validates all card JSON files against the Aurora schema copy co-located with the model's Mission card.
cards.name: Validate Aurora Schema

cards.description: aurora_cli validates the model invariants defined by the Aurora specification (single Mission root, directed graph away from Mission with only local cycles, all non-Mission/non-Note cards have inbound links, and all link targets exist).
cards.name: Validate Aurora Graph Invariants

cards.description: aurora_cli accepts an input path that resolves to either (a) an Aurora model root folder (an aurora folder containing one or more Mission cards and a schema copy), (b) a parent folder that contains an aurora folder, or (c) a Mission card JSON file. If multiple Mission cards are present in a shared aurora folder, aurora_cli processes each Mission as a separate model rooted at that Mission.
cards.name: Accept Model Root Or Mission Path

cards.description: aurora_cli generates one Markdown file per card, mirroring the model folder structure, using the JSON filename and card name as the H1 with the card id placed at the end.
cards.name: Generate Human-Friendly Markdown Cards

cards.description: aurora_cli generates one index README per Mission, grouped by card type starting with that Mission and linking to every generated Markdown card using the card name as link text. When multiple Missions are processed in a single run, aurora_cli also generates an aggregate index README that links to each per-Mission index.
cards.name: Generate Card Index README

cards.description: aurora_cli generates the standard view set (Requirements View, System Composition, Deployment Topology, Process Flow, and State Machine) from the cards present in the model.
cards.name: Generate Standard Views

cards.description: aurora_cli skips generating any standard view whose included card types are absent from the model.
cards.name: Skip Empty Views

cards.description: Generated view diagrams include a standard Mermaid init header configuring the flowchart renderer to ELK and distinguish card types with distinct, consistent node shapes.
cards.name: Use ELK Layout And Type Shapes

cards.description: aurora_cli writes generated Markdown cards, index README(s), and views to a single configurable output root folder; by default it writes to docs/design/ and creates a per-Mission output folder under docs/design/{MissionId}/ with cards under docs/design/{MissionId}/cards/ and views under docs/design/{MissionId}/views/. aurora_cli creates missing output directories by default and provides a flag to disable directory creation (failing if required output directories do not already exist).
cards.name: Configurable Output Folders

cards.description: aurora_cli includes the standard Mermaid classDef palette and assigns the appropriate class to every node by card type in every generated view diagram.
cards.name: Standard Mermaid Styling

cards.description: When an explicit input path is not provided, aurora_cli discovers a default Aurora model root by locating the nearest docs/design/aurora/ folder within the workspace root and uses it as the input model root.
cards.name: Discover Default Input Model

cards.description: aurora_cli provides commands to bump a card's audit_trail.version using semantic version rules: bump-major increments major and resets minor and patch to 0; bump-minor increments minor and resets patch to 0; bump-patch increments patch.
cards.name: Bump Audit Trail Version

cards.description: When bumping audit_trail.version, aurora_cli appends a new audit_trail.history entry. The entry event is 'created' if the history is empty; otherwise it is 'edited'.
cards.name: Append Audit Trail History Entry

cards.description: For version bump operations, aurora_cli sets audit_trail.history[].editor to an explicit CLI option when provided; otherwise it derives the editor identity from the logged-in OS user.
cards.name: Derive Editor Identity

cards.description: For version bump operations, aurora_cli generates audit_trail.history[].timestamp automatically in RFC3339 UTC format with millisecond precision using chrono.
cards.name: Generate Audit Timestamps

cards.description: The CLI provides a compact export command that emits the model as a single JSON file for machine consumption, removing fields that are not needed for topology/trace analysis (at minimum: audit_trail and links[].relationship), while preserving stable ordering for diff-friendly output.
cards.name: Export Compact Model Snapshot

cards.name: Initialized

cards.name: Loaded
